'''''Regina Cayli''''' was a [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ''Regina Cayli'' was on active duty at [[New Bakstre]] and was tasked to secure the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] vessel ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' on the surface after [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] forced down the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].

==Description==
The ''Regina Cayli'' was an [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was split over two decks; the Transport Deck and the Command Deck. The Transport Deck, in the lower half of the ship, consisted of a cargo bay with boarding ramp. A security console linked the ship's system was located in the bay, and there was enough room to park two [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]].<ref name="Regina" />

The upper deck, known as the Command Deck, was the location of the ship's [[Medical bay/Legends|infirmary]], which contained a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] and was staffed by a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]]. Situated in Room B12, the infirmary required a security code to access it. Travel between the levels was achieved by using [[grav tube]]s. [[Escape pod/Legends|Escape pods]] were situated at the top of the ship, and its armament including [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] ports.<ref name="Regina" />

The ''Regina Cayli'' was employed as a troop transport by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Its complement included at least two squads of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], supported by landspeeders.<ref name="Regina" />

==History==
[[File:RoarkGarnet.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Roark Garnet rescued his co-pilot from the ''Regina Cayli'']]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Regina Cayli'' was present at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Bakstre]] when the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' was forced down by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]]. The ''Regina Cayli'' was dispatched to investigate the crash site, where they wounded and captured [[Hawk Carrow]], the ship's co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Holding him prisoner in the infirmary, the medical droid treated his injured [[Limb/Legends|leg]] by encasing it in a [[healing sheath]]. The ship was subsequently infiltrated by Carrow's partner, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], who rescued his friend.<ref name="Regina" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Regina Cayli'' was [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by a [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Regina Cayli)|Commander]], and the stormtrooper contingent included Squads [[Squad Four (Regina Cayli)|Four]] and [[Squad Five (Regina Cayli)|Five]].<ref name="Regina" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Regina Cayli'' was featured in the roleplaying adventure "[[Regina Cayli (adventure)|Regina Cayli]]," first published in [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] by [[West End Games]] in [[1987]].
